name: Automatic redelivery admission over trusted current facts

semantic_ids.field_id_rule: Append the exact output field name, including underscores, to field_prefix.

input_order.name: method
input_order.meaning: Exact method spelling; no empty default, trim or case folding.

input_order.name: delivery_state
input_order.meaning: Trusted aggregate state of the WHOLE bound logical operation across all relevant attempts/claims, not just the latest attempt.

input_order.name: body_replayable
input_order.meaning: Host can reconstruct the exact bound original body bytes or positively establishes no body.

input_order.name: idempotency_key_present
input_order.meaning: The same nonempty effective key will actually be sent in the same verified scope; pointer/header-map presence is insufficient.

input_order.name: server_repeat_contract_verified
input_order.meaning: Host verified the current endpoint repeat contract for this exact request; read-like repeat semantics or server key/request deduplication in its retained account/context/time scope. Method names or ALLOW alone do not establish this.

input_order.name: request_binding_current
input_order.meaning: Host verified the same logical operation ID, aggregate attempt history, original method/target/body/key, effective account/context/version/mode, current authority/contract generations and applicable provider-guidance observation against current trusted state.

input_order.name: current_access_allowed
input_order.meaning: Trusted host established current authority needed by the selected operation, including lookup/read/disclosure or fact refresh as applicable. A supplied true is not authentication; the host separately authorizes the actual selected effect.

input_order.name: attempts_remaining
input_order.meaning: Remaining application dispatch claims from a trusted durable ledger; not physical wire sends, SDK retry iterations or a latency forecast.

input_order.name: provider_retry_guidance
input_order.meaning: Trusted current provider retry guidance bound to this same logical operation/request/effective scope and applicable observation cohort. It is an explicit independent input, not encoded by falsifying other facts.

echo_rule: Fields0..8 preserve all nine decoded original scalar inputs exactly and in order for every produced report, including well-typed semantic-invalid enums and signed-int64 attempt boundaries. Do not default, normalize, narrow, trim or coerce any input. Raw JSON bytes/identity require a separate host input digest.

wire_boundary.logical_request: Exactly the nine named fields above, all explicitly present, with the stated exact scalar kinds. A future native transport adapter must preserve these nine positional values using pinned839 supported scalar input syntax; this is not a Gooo List/record input or an assumed bareCLI decoder policy.
wire_boundary.Text: Decoded valid Unicode scalar UTF-8 of at most1024 bytes for each Text input. Unknown enum values within that wire domain are semantic-invalid and are echoed.
wire_boundary.Integer: Signed int64 JSON integer tokens only, from -9223372036854775808 to9223372036854775807. Reject decimal/exponent spellings and booleans as integers; values outside0..2 but within signedint64 produce INVALID_INPUT with exact echo.
wire_boundary.no_fabricated_result: Wire-invalid input is refused outside the Gooo activity and produces no fabricated policy report. The future strict host boundary needs its own fresh verification; no bareCLI rejection PASS is inherited.

guidance_meaning.ALLOW: Authenticated/current applicable provider guidance explicitly permits retry. It does not establish current authority, binding, budget, body replayability, aggregate nonapplication, a server repeat contract or a bound key. All guards still apply.
guidance_meaning.VETO: Authenticated/current applicable provider guidance explicitly refuses a NEW dispatch. It wins over budget/body/positive-nonapplication/repeat eligibility but does not suppress a prior authorized APPLIED_CONFIRMED lookup-only branch.
guidance_meaning.ABSENT: Host positively established no applicable retry directive: a complete authenticated relevant response lacks it, or trustworthy whole-operation evidence establishes no applicable provider response/directive (for example an operation never sent). Absence is not permission by itself; independent positive nonapplication or verified repeat guards remain required.
guidance_meaning.UNKNOWN: Applicable response/directive is unavailable, partial, unverified, stale, ambiguously scoped or otherwise not established. This is not trustworthy absence. After earlier guards it requests trusted machine refresh even for NOT_SENT/NOT_APPLIED_CONFIRMED.

delivery_state_meaning.NOT_SENT: Positive trusted evidence that NO relevant attempt/claim for this logical operation could have reached the provider or applied. A latest unsent attempt cannot erase an earlier unknown/inflight attempt.
delivery_state_meaning.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: Any relevant prior/current claim has unresolved receipt/application/inflight state. Timeout, lost response, cached500, lookup absence, or a latest validation refusal while an earlier claim is unresolved remain here.
delivery_state_meaning.APPLIED_CONFIRMED: Positive authoritative evidence establishes an applied business operation. It does NOT establish that the original response or recorded result is available. Response replay markers/cached errors alone do not establish this state.
delivery_state_meaning.NOT_APPLIED_CONFIRMED: Positive terminal nonapplication evidence settles ALL relevant operation attempts/claims, with no unknown/inflight earlier effect. One4xx/validation refusal/latest failed attempt or lookup absence is insufficient.

ordered_first_match_rules.when: Any well-typed method/state/guidance value is outside its exact listed enum, or attempts_remaining is outside0..2.
Prior rules did not select and request_binding_current=false.
Prior rules did not select and delivery_state=APPLIED_CONFIRMED.
Prior rules did not select and provider_retry_guidance=VETO.
Prior rules did not select and attempts_remaining=0.
Prior rules did not select and body_replayable=false.
Prior rules did not select and provider_retry_guidance=UNKNOWN.
Prior rules did not select and delivery_state is NOT_SENT or NOT_APPLIED_CONFIRMED.
Prior rules did not select; delivery_state is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and server_repeat_contract_verified=false.
Prior rules did not select; delivery_state is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and method is GET/HEAD/OPTIONS/TRACE.
Prior rules did not select; delivery_state is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and method is POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE and idempotency_key_present=false.
All earlier rules did not select; delivery_state is OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, method is POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, and verified server contract plus the bound nonempty key are present.

derived_fields.attempts_if_claimed: If and only if eligible_to_claim, attempts_remaining-1; every other branch echoes attempts_remaining exactly. Subtraction is permitted only after valid domain and positive budget select eligibility. No arithmetic is evaluated on semantic-invalid signedint64 extremes. This is hypothetical, not a reservation.
derived_fields.dedup_required: Exactly valid semantic domain AND delivery_state==OUTCOME_UNKNOWN AND method in POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, irrespective of selected action, current access, binding, VETO, UNKNOWN, budget or body. Thus true may accompany STOP/REFRESH. It describes a requirement, not a claim/send instruction.

action_effect_boundary.LOOKUP_RECORDED_RESULT: Lookup-only request under current lookup/read/disclosure authority and binding. Zero new dispatch/effect/attempt claim. Missing/unavailable lookup can remain unresolved and MUST NOT downgrade APPLIED_CONFIRMED to nonapplication or enable redelivery. No result availability, response reconstruction or liveness is promised.
action_effect_boundary.REFRESH_OUTCOME: Request trusted machine refresh/reconciliation of relevant facts under the required current read/disclosure authority; no new dispatch. Refresh may remain unresolved.
action_effect_boundary.STOP: No new dispatch or attempt claim.
action_effect_boundary.REDELIVER_ELIGIBLE: A pure admission result only. Trusted host must atomically claim one application attempt while rechecking current facts/authority/bindings before sending the exact bound request. The Gooo result itself performs no claim, network call or effect.

trusted_host_obligations: Bind durable logical operationID and ALL relevant attempt/claim outcomes; latest-attempt status cannot replace aggregate history.

Bind final effective method/origin/target/body bytes/nonempty sent key/parameter semantics, account/context/API family+version/test-live mode/header overrides and operation identity. Do not change the key or operation identity to escape an unknown outcome.

Bind provider guidance provenance, the same current applicable observation cohort and response identity to that operation/request/effective scope/contract/authority epoch. Do not reuse a convenient stale ALLOW/VETO or treat unavailable guidance as ABSENT; unresolved conflicting observations remain UNKNOWN.

Verify current server contract and retained scope using original first-attempt age, durable time evidence and clock uncertainty. Unknown/near-expired retention cannot assert a verified unresolved-write repeat contract. No exact provider-expiry timestamp is inferred.
Independently authenticate current authority, including the actual selected send/lookup/disclosure/refresh action. Caller-supplied booleans are compared facts, not proof.

After eligibility atomically claim one application attempt against the current ledger revision while rechecking operation/request/key/body/account/context/contract/authority/observation binding. Lost compare-and-swap, stale generation or revocation yields zero dispatch and fresh facts.

Own SDK/transport/application retry layers and record the outcome durably. attempts_remaining counts application claims only; no physical wire-send, end-to-end deadline, durability or exactly-once guarantee follows.

Saved replay reconstructs the prior decision, not current permission/contract/claim/effect. Verified cases may proceed automatically; unknown/refused states refresh or stop automatically without requiring human per-call approval.

full_finite_domain_plan.order: Nested input-order loops with each listed domain order; last provider_retry_guidance varies fastest. Include every tuple without pruning apparently inconsistent trusted-fact combinations. The pure policy has deterministic values even when a caller asserts inconsistent facts; it does not verify their truth.
full_finite_domain_plan.comparison: All15 required field types/values, all9 exact echoes, exact IDs and first-match reasons; no old3072 coverage/PASS reuse. Native/saved-replay batching, strict wire negatives, tamper controls, host controls and finite runtime/storage budget remain root-owned later gates.
full_finite_domain_plan.partition_limit: Static contract crosschecks, not executed candidate results or a substitute for independently deriving expected values.

limits: Original policy over supplied trusted facts, not authentication or actual provider evidence.
No completed endpoint adapter, real API dispatch, whole Transport/SDK port, physical-send cap, production/full-safety, performance, adoption or guaranteed-liveness claim.

The semantic specification was frozen before the Gooo candidate; the independent reference policy was authored from that specification without reading the candidate. Public metadata normalization does not alter its rules.
